text: That afternoon: Holmes shows that the rope is fastened to a hook above the ventilator

text: What was the bell-rope put there for? — to give a reason for having a hook at that spot

why: Nothing in the story suggests a hook at that spot needed justifying; the hook is mentioned only as what holds the rope, so a reader has no reason yet to consider this.

why: Holmes finds it is a dummy, not even attached to a wire, which bears directly on the rope's purpose.

text: What was the bell-rope put there for? — it runs from just above the opening of the ventilator down to the pillow
